title: Eight Winters and One Short Note
subtitle: 新闻媒体 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 新闻媒体（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）
meta: 主题语境：新闻媒体（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通）　|　核心词汇：exposure　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exposure 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 my aunt ① wrote an exposure that no editor in the city would have printed, and she said the writing was the whole of the winter. The ② exposure, meaning the report itself and not the rumour, ran eight winters and stayed unprinted in the book; an exposure, she said, is the only thing in a city that is judged by how long it is left unprinted.

Every ③ exposure in that city had the same short note beside it, and the ④ exposure at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the court and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An exposure, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to print; my aunt said the printing is the part that fills eight winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the exposure was the whole of the case, meaning the revealing and not the report. The ⑥ exposure, meaning the revealing and not any of that, is the only thing in a case that everybody waits for and nobody prints; exposure, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a report and a revealing. He said the revealing is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ exposure had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short note. The ⑧ exposure of the whole thing, my aunt wrote in January, was one city and eight winters of printing; exposure, she said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to print. She said the printing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ exposure I remember is the one printed in the file, which closed in 1981 and is still described as the quietest in the city. An ⑩ exposure, my mother said in 1983, is the only one that improves by being printed; every exposure, she said, is a revealing that has agreed to look like a report. She said the revealing was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 曝光报道；揭露（指城里每一篇旁边的那一篇）
B. n. 揭露（指那一篇本身，与传闻相对）
C. 固定搭配：write an exposure 写一篇曝光报道
D. n. 揭露（指留给法庭的那一篇）
E. n. 揭露（抽象总称，指一座城市的曝光之事）
F. n. 揭露（指卷宗上写到、被刊出的那一篇）
G. n. 暴露；揭露的行为（指一个案子里人人都等却无人刊出的那样东西）
H. n. 暴露（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人刊出的那样东西）

items.q: wrote an exposure that no editor in the city would have printed
The exposure, meaning the report itself and not the rumour
the exposure at the far side

answers.why: write an exposure 意为“写一篇曝光报道”，1971 年姑姑写了一篇城里没有一位编辑肯刊出的曝光报道。
exposure 意为“揭露”，指那一篇本身而不是传闻，它经过了八个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
exposure 意为“曝光报道”，指城里每一篇旁边的那一篇，每一篇旁边都有同一张短短的字条。
exposure 意为“揭露”，指留给法庭的那一篇，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
exposure 意为“暴露、揭露的行为”，指一个案子里人人都等却无人刊出的那样东西，叔叔说这次揭露就是那个案子的全部。
exposure 意为“暴露”，指人人都等却无人刊出的那样东西而不是那一篇报道，是案子里人人都等、却无人刊出的东西。
exposure 意为“揭露”，指卷宗上写到、被刊出的那一篇，到 1978 年这一篇成了卷宗里的一行。
exposure 意为“揭露”，姑姑一月写道，整件事的曝光之事是一座城市和八个冬天的刊出。
exposure 意为“揭露”，我记得的是卷宗上刊出的那一篇，1981 年结束了，至今仍被说成城里最安静的一篇。
exposure 为抽象总称，母亲 1983 年说，一篇揭露是唯一会因为被好好刊出而变得更好的东西。
